title: move the back-fill data button
body:
currently the backfill-data button is located in settings->cloud-upload->api upload(REST)->extra options
since this feature also works without using the rest api, it seems to me, that it would be clearer and easier to find, if it where located in settings->cloud-upload->extra options. (this assumes, that the other extra options are also independent of which way you connect to the db)
